startId.description: id for the start date input. Label and hint ids are derived from this.

endId.description: id for the end date input. Label and hint ids are derived from this.

startName.description: name attribute for the start date input. Defaults to startId.

endName.description: name attribute for the end date input. Defaults to endId.

startLabel.description: Label text for the start date field.

endLabel.description: Label text for the end date field.

startHint.description: Hint text displayed below the start date label.

endHint.description: Hint text displayed below the end date label.

startError.description: Error message for the start date field.

endError.description: Error message for the end date field.

defaultStartDate.description: Initial start date (yyyy-mm-dd). Sets data-default-value on the start usa-date-picker wrapper.

defaultEndDate.description: Initial end date (yyyy-mm-dd). Sets data-default-value on the end usa-date-picker wrapper.

minDate.description: Earliest selectable date (yyyy-mm-dd). Sets data-min-date on the usa-date-range-picker wrapper.

maxDate.description: Latest selectable date (yyyy-mm-dd). Sets data-max-date on the usa-date-range-picker wrapper.

className.description: Additional classes for the usa-date-range-picker wrapper.
